items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that won't strip skin that looks dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support a moisture score of 41.5 and a comfortable skin barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides helps shield the look of dark patches from sun and visible light, and suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Please check your hydroquinone cream with your doctor or midwife before continuing, and hold off on adding any more brightening products until they have advised you. Use the cleanser and cream morning and night, and apply the SPF last every morning, reapplying if you are outdoors.
